Region: world / Netherlands reference plant (Hoogovens) and IISI reference plant; technology assessment as of 1997-98. Locators are printed journal page numbers (123-205). Previously registered as NOT HELD LOCALLY (cited by UKERC); this extraction uses the existing id. Loaded: the seven smelting reduction processes (coal t/thm converted to GJ/thm at the authors LHV 29-32 GJ/t, electricity, oxygen and export gas/steam flows, direct investment cost and variable/total production cost), the reference coke-oven/sinter/BF route, near-net-shape casting (final energy from Table 10; capex and cost indices), scrap-melting furnaces (Table 12 physical inputs converted to final energy), Arex DRI, waste-heat measures to _measures. Not loaded: all primary-energy SECs (Tables 8, 10, 12) and Figure 18 (future-route SECs are a figure, primary energy), exergy analysis (Tables 5-7), history. TRAPS: (1) Almost all data are design values or pilot-plant results from the 1990s, not operating averages. (2) Costs are US dollars without a price year; direct investment costs only, per t hot metal of annual capacity; the thin slab casters printed as US$200/thm and US$300/thm probably mean per t strip. (3) Authors own estimates are used for liquid core reduction, strip and spray casting. (4) Table 8 HIsmelt high case (14.2) is lower than the low case (15.3). (5) Coal heating value assumed 29-32 GJ/t; the low-high ranges come from that assumption, not from process uncertainty. (6) Export gas LHV basis not stated.
